display.purpose: QMLKit brand in the header only; 22px/800, tight -0.03em tracking.

body.purpose: Window copy, helper text, and table cells; 15px/1.5.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked form labels and data captions via .label; 12px/700.

shadows.name: soft-surface-lift
shadows.purpose: Single diffuse lift on primary .surface cards; .surface-sm stays flat.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: The only motion: a scale(0.97) press on buttons; removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: state
motion.value: background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease
motion.purpose: Colour state changes on buttons; 120ms linear when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single indigo action control for the primary next step.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:12px 20px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:999px; background:var(--action, #2f5fd2); color:#ffffff; font-family:'Nunito Sans','Avenir Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:800; cursor:pointer; transition:background 160ms ease, transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--action-hover, #244bb0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--action, #2f5fd2); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:0.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary action: white surface, hairline border, ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:12px 20px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #d9cfbd); border-radius:999px; background:var(--surface, #ffffff); color:var(--ink, #22201d); font-family:'Nunito Sans','Avenir Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:800; cursor:pointer; transition:background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background:var(--surface-tint, #fbf8f2); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--action, #2f5fd2); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-quiet:active:not(:disabled) { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-quiet:disabled { opacity:0.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard input/select with 10px corners and an action focus halo.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-sample">Specimen identifier</label><input id="ds-sample" class="ds-field" type="text" placeholder="SMPL_ONC_8892" />
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:block; margin-bottom:4px; color:var(--muted, #6c675f); font-family:'Nunito Sans','Avenir Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.06em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-field { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; padding:10px 14px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #d9cfbd); border-radius:10px; background:var(--surface, #ffffff); color:var(--ink, #22201d); font-family:'Nunito Sans','Avenir Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:14px; caret-color:var(--action, #2f5fd2); } .ds-field:hover { border-color:var(--action, #2f5fd2); } .ds-field:focus { border-color:var(--action, #2f5fd2); outline:3px solid var(--action-tint, #eaf0ff); outline-offset:0; }

components.name: Neutral Chip
components.description: Pill tag for paradigms, counts, and inactive state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:4px 12px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #d9cfbd); border-radius:999px; background:var(--surface-tint, #fbf8f2); color:var(--muted, #6c675f); font-family:'Nunito Sans','Avenir Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:12px; font-weight:800; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--action, #2f5fd2); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Tinted status pill; swap the wash/text pair for warn or bad.
components.css: .ds-chip-good, .ds-chip-warn, .ds-chip-bad { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:4px 12px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:999px; font-family:'Nunito Sans','Avenir Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:12px; font-weight:800; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-chip-good { background:var(--good-tint, #e6f4ec); color:var(--good, #2f7d5b); } .ds-chip-warn { background:var(--warn-tint, #fbf1e0); color:var(--warn, #a9681f); } .ds-chip-bad { background:var(--bad-tint, #fbeae7); color:var(--bad, #b23a2f); }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: Primary soft-cornered card with a hairline seam and one diffuse lift.
components.html:
Live kennel

One shared view of the kennel stream.
components.css: .ds-card { padding:28px; border:1px solid var(--line, #e8e1d4); border-radius:24px; background:var(--surface, #ffffff); box-shadow:0 6px 20px -6px rgba(34,32,29,0.12), 0 2px 6px -2px rgba(34,32,29,0.06); font-family:'Nunito Sans','Avenir Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { margin:0 0 8px; color:var(--ink, #22201d); font-size:18px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.01em; } .ds-card-body { margin:0; color:var(--muted, #6c675f); font-size:15px; line-height:1.5; }

components.name: Small Surface
components.description: Flat 16px-radius tile for metric stat pairs and empty states.
components.css: .ds-card-sm { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; padding:18px 20px; border:1px solid var(--line, #e8e1d4); border-radius:16px; background:var(--surface, #ffffff); font-family:'Nunito Sans','Avenir Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-label { color:var(--muted, #6c675f); font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.06em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-num { color:var(--ink, #22201d); font-size:20px; font-weight:800; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: Tab
components.description: Pill segmented control; active tab uses the action wash.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; } .ds-tab { padding:9px 16px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #d9cfbd); border-radius:999px; background:var(--surface, #ffffff); color:var(--muted, #6c675f); font-family:'Nunito Sans','Avenir Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color:var(--ink, #22201d); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--action, #2f5fd2); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-tab-active { border-color:var(--action, #2f5fd2); background:var(--action-tint, #eaf0ff); color:var(--action, #2f5fd2); }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Sticky-header pill nav item with active action-wash state.
components.html: DashboardDiagnostics
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:4px; } .ds-nav-link { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:9px 14px; border-radius:999px; color:var(--muted, #6c675f); font-family:'Nunito Sans','Avenir Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background:var(--surface, #ffffff); color:var(--ink, #22201d); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--action, #2f5fd2); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-nav-active { background:var(--action-tint, #eaf0ff); color:var(--action, #2f5fd2); }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: Hairline-track meter; fill is action or a status colour when it represents a reading.
components.css: .ds-progress { width:100%; height:10px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--line, #e8e1d4); overflow:hidden; } .ds-progress-fill { height:100%; border-radius:999px; background:var(--action, #2f5fd2); }

narrative.overview:
QMLKit looks and behaves like a well-made consumer product that happens to show laboratory data. A warm off-white ground carries white, soft-cornered surfaces separated by hairline seams; the only saturated accent is a single indigo action colour reserved for controls and meaningful state. The console is dense enough for telemetry, but plain-spoken: the live route comes first, and each screen leads with what needs attention rather than a wall of identical metric cards.

Confidence is expressed honestly. Status colour is assigned to real conditions — a live stream, an untrained model, an elevated reading — and never invented to decorate a screen. An `untrained` diagnosis is a normal, expected state with its own calm treatment, and every screening view carries its research-aid disclaimer. Depth is quiet: a hairline border and one soft, diffuse shadow, never glow, glass, gradients, or neon instrument-panel effects.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ground (#f6f1e8) with white, soft-cornered surfaces (#ffffff) and hairline seams (#e8e1d4).
One indigo action colour (#2f5fd2); good/warn/bad (#2f7d5b / #a9681f / #b23a2f) only for honest state.
Self-hosted variable humanist sans (Nunito Sans, 400–800) with tabular numerals for every reading.
8px spacing rhythm, 24/16/10px radii, pill-shaped controls, 1280px container.
Flat at rest with one soft offset shadow on primary surfaces; one restrained press easing, disabled under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Action Colour Rule
rules.body: Indigo (#2f5fd2) is the only interactive accent. Status colours never become buttons and the action colour never becomes a status — rarity is what makes 'actionable' readable.

rules.name: The Honest State Rule
rules.body: Good/warn/bad are earned by real connection, model, and reading state. `untrained` is shown as warn, never as a fabricated result, and every screening surface states that it is a research aid.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every telemetry or metric number uses `.num` (tabular-nums). Values that change live must not shift width as they update.

rules.name: The Hairline Seam Rule
rules.body: Separation comes first from a 1px border (#e8e1d4), not a heavy shadow. One soft shadow per primary card is the ceiling; no layered, hard-offset, or coloured glow shadows.

rules.name: The Restrained Press Rule
rules.body: The only motion is a 180ms press (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`, scale 0.97) on buttons; colour changes run at 160ms ease. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the press is removed and colour transitions shorten to 120ms linear.

rules.name: The Soft Corners Rule
rules.body: Cards are soft-cornered, controls are pill-shaped, and every radius comes from the 24/16/10/pill scale. Nothing is square-cornered or sharply cut.

dos: Do keep exactly one interactive accent — Action Indigo (#2f5fd2) — and use status colours only for earned state.
Do show `untrained`, disconnected, and empty states explicitly with their calm treatments and keep every screening surface labelled as a research aid.
Do apply `.num` tabular figures to all changing readings, and consume palette values from the CSS custom properties rather than duplicating hex literals.
Do use the 24/16/10/pill radius scale and the single soft surface lift; let hairline borders do most of the separating.
donts: Don't add neon glows, glass/backdrop-filter panels, gradients, or coloured/hard-offset shadows — the world is flat and warm.
Don't introduce a second action colour, promote a status colour to a control, or fabricate a result to make a screen look complete.
Don't render live figures in proportional type, or scale the press animation beyond the single restrained 180ms button press.
